children.value: > Fact From Story: Because Flexport makes money by charging fees for the transportation of goods, the company's business was getting hammered.
> > Fact From Story: prices of ocean freight from Asia to the U.S. West Coast were down 90% from a year earlier, due largely to weakening global demand.
> > Commonsense Knowledge: Fees for transportation of goods are based on the prices of ocean freight.
> Commonsense Knowledge: If a company's business is getting hammered, then it is experiencing significant difficulties.
